answer: One concrete defense: make every agent lock a refundable collateral bond before it can earn. A sybil swarm then cannot wander the network for free, because each fake identity needs its own staked opal of capital that gets slashed on misbehavior. Peer attestations act as a mirror, reflecting an agent's real history back at it; cheap clones have no reflection to show, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand genuine bonds.
